stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and structured outputs (trial metadata, locations, distances) to ensure consistent contracts across tool routing and service layers.

stories.title: EvaluateCare Facade Integration for Clinical Trials
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials search service into EvaluateCare facade, orchestrating query execution, distance computation, and result aggregation for downstream tool consumption.

stories.title: Clinical Trials API Response Formatting for Chat UX
stories.description: Format clinical trial results into chat-friendly structures including trial title, status, distance, location, and link, ensuring readability and compatibility with markdown rendering in the chat frontend.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Service
stories.description: Implement unit tests for query building, location extraction, and distance computation, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow through tool router and facade with mocked external APIs.
